title: Group Anagrams
description:
Write a function `group_anagrams(words)` that takes a list of strings and groups anagrams together.

Return a list of lists where each inner list contains words that are anagrams of each other. The order of groups and words within groups does not matter — but the test expects sorted output for verification.
hint: Use a dictionary with the sorted string as key. All anagrams share the same sorted key.
outputExplanation: group_anagrams(["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"]) groups them by sorted characters: "aet"→["ate","eat","tea"], "ant"→["nat","tan"], "abt"→["bat"].
